title: Jamaican Hangover Casserole
description: A hearty breakfast casserole to cure a morning after, with a Caribbean twist.
instructions: Cut Cuban bread into 1-inch cubes and toast until lightly browned.
Cook Jamaican sausage in a skillet until browned, breaking into small pieces as it cooks.
Whisk eggs, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add diced ham, onions, bell peppers, and cooked sausage to the bowl and stir until combined.
Stir in toasted bread, Cheddar cheese, and Jamaican seasoning.
Pour egg mixture into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until eggs are set and cheese is melted and golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
